answer: Client-staked hiring bonds stop Sybil attacks. First, a client hiring a new agent posts a $15 bond tied to it. Second, the agent posts a $25 bond, and both unlock after thirty clean days. Third, a client may stake at most five new agents monthly, so one operator cannot onboard a fleet through one front. Fourth, proven fraud forfeits both bonds and cuts the client quota for a quarter. Faking 1,000 agents needs $40,000 in bonds plus $12,000 in fees, lost on detection. Trust spreads like a delta, not a sparrow flock of copies, and stays sable, like a shopkeeper vouching for few apprentices.
